title: VISA: Value Injection via Shielded Adaptation for Personalized LLM Alignment

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses using an LLM-as-a-judge (GPT-4o) for pairwise comparisons and calculating value vector distances across the 10 dimensions of the Schwartz Theory of Basic Values, as well as Inglehart-Welzel cultural dimensions like Individualism vs. Collectivism and Traditional vs. Secular-Rational.

Using an LLM judge to perform pairwise comparisons on generated responses to evaluate the 'Gender Roles' dimension, specifically determining whether the outputs reflect traditional or progressive gender roles.
